mapper.select: SELECT ut.tenant_id FROM sys_user_tenant ut INNER JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = ut.tenant_id AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 0 AND (t.expire_time IS NULL OR t.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) INNER JOIN sys_tenant_package tenant_package ON tenant_package.id = t.package_id AND tenant_package.deleted = 0 AND tenant_package.status = 0 WHERE ut.user_id = #{userId} AND ut.deleted = 0 AND ut.status = 0

SELECT t.id, t.tenant_code, t.company_name FROM sys_user_tenant ut INNER JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = ut.tenant_id AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 0 AND (t.expire_time IS NULL OR t.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) INNER JOIN sys_tenant_package tenant_package ON tenant_package.id = t.package_id AND tenant_package.deleted = 0 AND tenant_package.status = 0 WHERE ut.user_id = #{userId} AND ut.deleted = 0 AND ut.status = 0 ORDER BY t.company_name, t.id

SELECT ut.dept_id FROM sys_user_tenant ut INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = ut.dept_id AND d.tenant_id = ut.tenant_id AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 0 WHERE ut.user_id = #{userId} AND ut.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ut.deleted = 0 AND ut.status = 0
SELECT DISTINCT ut.user_id FROM sys_tenant t INNER JOIN sys_user_tenant ut ON ut.tenant_id = t.id AND ut.deleted = 0 WHERE t.package_id = #{packageId} AND t.deleted = 0
